name: Ironman
teaser: Ironman Profiles to apply rules and modifiers to make the game scoped to "Ironman" adjacent. Similar to Ironman modes in other games.
description:
Ironman

Ironman adds a high-risk progression system to new custom profile editions within SPT, with multiple tiers and meaningful consequences for death.

Features

  • Three new profile editions: Standard, Ultimate, and Hardcore Ironman
  • The features and rules only apply to Ironman profile editions
  • Death-based item and currency losses
  • Skill and character XP loss
  • Limited currency balances
  • Trader and healing restrictions
  • Ultimate & Hardcore profile editions will be prompted an optional downgrade once per day on death. Choose wisely as this is not reversible
  • Profile edition based bonuses and potential level rewards
  • …and more! Read the SIC page for details about each Profile and their rules

The mod should not do anything unless you make a new profile and specifically select, and play on an Ironman profile edition.

This mod is still in development, so some things may be incorrectly handled but all testing solo, non-Fika, has been successful. If you have any issues please report them so they can be resolved.

At this time the mod is not marked as compatible with Fika, because I cannot test it with multiple profile types or mixed profiles. Test at your own peril. This mod has also not been extensively tested with other mods, just mine. If you run into issues, you also need to report those.

Note: Visit the Ironman web page within the SIC or directly (see Config tab) for detailed information about each profile type, its restrictions, bonuses. You can also view existing Ironman profiles and their stats.

INSTALLATION
  1. Download Ironman
  2. Open the downloaded zip file in 7-zip
  3. Select the SPT & BepInEx folders in the zip file in 7-zip
  4. Drag the SPT & BepInEx folders from 7-zip into your SPT folder

Demonstration Video (yoink):

UNINSTALLATION
  1. Launch the server and then launcher, then delete any Ironman profiles you have made.
  2. If you have given yourself any of the containers added by this mod to other profiles, you must delete them first.
  3. Delete /ROOTSPT/Bepinex/plugins/acidphantasm-ironman
  4. Delete /ROOTSPT/SPT/user/mods/acidphantasm-ironman
  5. Done

Uninstallation is not guaranteed, since this mod does add custom containers for the Ironman protections (both starting out and as you level)

But following the steps above properly should be OK. If you have never used the Ironman profiles, or given yourself any of the container there is no harm in uninstalling this mod.

CONFIG

Configuration

To edit the configuration run your server after installing and go to:

  • https://127.0.0.1:6969/ironman/

The configuration is not very wide at this moment. This is intended. If you dont’ like how difficult a profile type is, choose an easier one. This mod is made to be a challenge.

If you are using Fika then put the appropriate IP and port instead.
